Sorry, but all these reviews suck and the owner probably told them to write a five star.

 So heres my reason why its 1 star (no hate just judging based on how i genuinely dont like how this was made.

 First off most things are heavily inspired or taken off of monkaroon (go play it if you havent).

 Secondly there were way too lazy to even write rules properly.
 
Third off, they have no original ideas for their game. 

Then, the game is extremely buggy having weird bugs that actually shouldn't even have been there.

Another reason, is that the game obviously has ai being used in it.

Finally, the game uses ai for their thumbnail, mall sign is just monkaroon's, and mall sucks terribly while also having the player model's (the monkey) arms being literal NOODLES😭. 

Theres much more but thats all imma say.
